test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a fundamental duty mentioned in the Indian Constitution?

options.text: Protect every monument or place of artistic or historic importance.
Provide early childhood care and education.
Prohibit slaughter of cows, calves and other milch animals.
Duty of parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child between age of six and fourteen years.

solution:
The correct answer is **__Duty of parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child between age of six and fourteen years__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 86th Amendment Act

 
 
• This amended act made elementary education a fundamental right.
 
• The newly-added Article 21-A declares that the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of 6 to 14 years.
 
• It changed the subject matter of Article 45 in Directive Principles, The State shall endeavour to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years.
 
• Also added a new fundamental duty under Article 51-A which is It shall be the duty of every citizen of India who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or ward between the age of six and fourteen years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Articles**
 **Provisions**
 
 

 Article 49
 Protect every monument or place of artistic or historic importance.
 
 

 Article 45
 Provide early childhood care and education.
 
 

 Article 48 
 Prohibit slaughter of cows, calves and other milch animals.
